items.title: Deltarune Chapter 6 is playable "from the beginning to the end," Toby Fox says, but the RPG's final part has "only just started"
items.en_title: Deltarune Chapter 6 is playable "from the beginning to the end," Toby Fox says, but the RPG's final part has "only just started"
items.en_oneliner: Toby Fox has updated fans on Deltarune Chapters 6 and 7: Chapter 6 is playable from beginning to end, but Chapter 7, the finale, has only just started.

items.title: Cultivation game tips hidden in world design
items.en_title: Cultivation game tips hidden in world design
items.en_oneliner: Recapping three days of development decisions, the author argues that cultivation games are best taught by the world itself — density, distance, and behavior — rather than by numbers.

items.title: Last card, Wild +4 and optional stacking: how I coded Colour Pile in JavaScript
items.en_title: Last card, Wild +4 and optional stacking: how I coded Colour Pile in JavaScript
items.en_oneliner: The author built a UNO-like shedding game in just over 400 lines of JavaScript, walking through how the 108-card deck, Skip, Reverse, +2, Wilds, and the shouted “Last card!” call were encoded.

items.title: GTA 6 players swore the weather system was broken and the latest patch has confirmed those suspicions
items.en_title: GTA 6 players swore the weather system was broken and the latest patch has confirmed those suspicions
items.en_oneliner: Players long suspected GTA 6’s weather system was broken, and Rockstar’s latest patch has confirmed it — bringing weather back to Leonida.

items.title: Epic Games no longer plans to include Blueprints or Actor Gameplay Framework in Unreal Engine 6
items.en_title: Epic Games no longer plans to include Blueprints or Actor Gameplay Framework in Unreal Engine 6
items.en_oneliner: Epic has changed course: Unreal Engine 6 will drop Blueprints and the Actor Gameplay Framework from day one in favor of AI-driven tooling, so developers used to visual scripting should start planning their migration now.

items.title: “Cyberpunk 2 is Canceled” Jokes CDPR Creative Director After Playing GTA 6
items.en_title: “Cyberpunk 2 is Canceled” Jokes CDPR Creative Director After Playing GTA 6
items.en_oneliner: After playing GTA 6, the Cyberpunk 2 creative director jokingly declared the sequel “canceled,” while praising Rockstar’s scale, density, coherence, and technology.

items.title: GTA 6 leaker reportedly releases file needed to run leaked Xbox build
items.en_title: GTA 6 leaker reportedly releases file needed to run leaked Xbox build
items.en_oneliner: Leaker Cyberleek has reportedly released the executable needed to run the leaked Xbox build of GTA 6, raising concern that an unofficial PC port could follow.

items.title: Activision calls Banjo-Kazooie one of its "iconic gaming franchises," raising hopes for long-awaited new game
items.en_title: Activision calls Banjo-Kazooie one of its "iconic gaming franchises," raising hopes for long-awaited new game
items.en_oneliner: Activision listed the long-dormant Rare platformer Banjo-Kazooie among its "iconic franchises" in a job posting, rekindling hopes for a long-awaited new game.

items.title: Major update 2.0.0
items.en_title: Major update 2.0.0
items.en_oneliner: Holonoptic’s 2.0.0 update adds a new ending, a new executive, 21 late-game projects, 91 achievements, and Steam Cloud saves — plus a fix so a cat on the keyboard can no longer open the debug menus.

items.title: Christmas games unblocked: what makes a seasonal browser game work (9 real examples)
items.en_title: Christmas games unblocked: what makes a seasonal browser game work (9 real examples)
items.en_oneliner: December's winning browser games keep a proven gameplay loop, dress it in festive visuals, and add a calendar hook only the holiday season can provide — nine real examples break down the formula.

items.title: Sea of Remnants: Set Sail for the Dawnbreaker Closed Beta on XBOX Series X
items.en_title: Sea of Remnants: Set Sail for the Dawnbreaker Closed Beta on XBOX Series X
items.en_oneliner: Sea of Remnants opens its Dawnbreaker closed beta test to Xbox Insiders on December 3, offering an early look at its strange sea creatures and ocean adventure.

items.title: Sites like Poki and CrazyGames: 10 free browser game sites compared (we run one of them)
items.en_title: Sites like Poki and CrazyGames: 10 free browser game sites compared (we run one of them)
items.en_oneliner: A side-by-side comparison of ten free browser-game platforms, covering traffic, monetization, and operations, with the author candidly listing the weak spots of SlowDen, the site they run themselves.

items.title: The 4-Line Camera Lerp Formula Every HTML5 & AI Game Developer Needs
items.en_title: The 4-Line Camera Lerp Formula Every HTML5 & AI Game Developer Needs

items.title: "We Cannot Believe We Are Reaching Milestones Like This" - Queen's Domain Dev Celebrates Opening Sales
items.en_title: "We Cannot Believe We Are Reaching Milestones Like This" - Queen's Domain Dev Celebrates Opening Sales
items.en_oneliner: The FromSoftware-inspired indie RPG Queen's Domain has sold over 300,000 copies in its opening stretch despite launching in one of the busiest release windows, and its developer reflects on the milestone.

items.title: Miolhr Lime Edition — The Living Miolhria Mega Update!
items.en_title: Miolhr Lime Edition — The Living Miolhria Mega Update!

items.en_title: Scopely partners with Marvel for Monopoly Go and Avengers: Doomsday crossover
items.en_oneliner: Scopely is teaming up with Marvel Games on an Avengers: Doomsday season for Monopoly Go, arriving ahead of the film's December 18 theatrical release.

items.en_oneliner: Deborah Ann Woll, who played Faye in God of War Ragnarok and next year's God of War Laufey, will reprise the role in Amazon Prime Video's upcoming live-action series.

items.en_title: Monopoly Go gets an Avengers: Doomsday season in Scopely’s third Marvel crossover

items.title: EU opens consultation on Digital Fairness Act

items.en_title: 21 MENA startups graduate from the third Exel by Merak accelerator cohort
items.en_oneliner: Saudi accelerator Exel by Merak graduated 21 MENA gaming startups from its third cohort at Demo Day, where the studios pitched to publishers, investors and fellow developers.

items.title: DevLog #13 - Three drums at nightfall: candombe comes to camp
items.en_title: DevLog #13 - Three drums at nightfall: candombe comes to camp

items.en_title: Fault Line free demo is out: modern RTS on real-world terrain

items.title: Solving Every Gravity Puzzle Level Before a Player Sees It

items.en_title: Dawn of War 4's newest trailer teases the appearance of a fan-favourite character in the game's post-launch DLC

items.title: Game Reskinning Explained: Cost, Risks and Store Rules

items.title: "Don't let this happen again": GTA 6 hacker who pleaded guilty to 2022 Rockstar Games breach released under supervision
